title: 2026 Zijing Cup — Gold Division Championship Account
content:
Our Ke-Guang-Chuan combined team fought its way to the Gold division championship in the Zijing Cup final. After Zhejiang University swept us 5–0 in our first group-stage match, who would have imagined that we would eventually win it back in a deciding match tiebreak?

The closest call was the third doubles match. Brother Xu and I were outplayed early and lost the first two games. With Xu taking the lead on serve and me holding firm at the net, we managed to force a match tiebreak. At 9–6, with match point, I hit a body serve on my first serve and won the point outright. The whole team rushed onto the court and hugged. Even our usually imposing star, Brother Da, had tears in his eyes.

Only afterward did everyone learn that the opposing team's ace, Qile Zhang, could not play third doubles in the final because his UTR rating exceeded the limit. We had figured out our opponents as we played and battled through.

This victory meant so much.

The PDF also shows a longer, truncated original-title reference: “2026 Zijing Cup — Gold Division Championship Account,” followed by a celebratory Chinese verse beginning “紫荆冠冕踏霜过 科广川头奏凯歌 胜负自凭儿女意 不劳金…” .
